title: Technology Sector Update for 01/24/2019: SMTC,LRCX,PTC,CTXS
text:

GOOG -0.36%
Technology stocks were eased slightly from their session highs this afternoon, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 rising nearly 0.7% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was racing more than 5.6% higher.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Semtech Corp ( SMTC ) rose over 3% on Thursday on a strong day for chipmakers. The company also was getting a boost from privately held Polysense Technologies integrating the company's LoRa devices and wireless radio frequency technology into its remote devices used to monitor building structure integrity.
In other sector news:
(+) Lam Research ( LRCX ) climbed as much as 16% on Thursday after the semiconductor processing equipment company reported fiscal Q2 net income and revenue topping analyst projections. It also authorized a new, $5 billion stock buyback program.
(-) PTC ( PTC ) declined almost 6% after analysts at Wedbush lowered their price target for the software services company by $8 to $100 a share. The brokerage reiterated its outperform rating for the stock.
(-) Citrix Systems ( CTXS ) retreated during Thursday trading, falling almost 7%, after the cloud-based virtualization company issued Q1 and FY19 financial projections trailing analyst forecasts. It sees net income for the current quarter ending March in a range of $1.15 to $1.20 per share on between $700 million to $710 million in revenue. The Street is at $1.37 per share and $726.6 million, respectively.
